verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page lists 'Easy financial data exports' as part of its bookkeeping offering, a first-party export capability, though only for financial data. Nothing shows a full-account export, which formats are used, or how to leave the service. missing for 10: export of all account data (mail scans, compliance records, tax filings, documents), documented open/standard export formats, offboarding or registered-agent transfer-out process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
